Beside it: Character.isLetter of an ASCII char, IntStream.range for the claim's own expression, and Logger.isLoggable below INFO as false under a stated assumption (the matcher's debug line through spring-jcl is not written). Each rule is proved to be its definition written out in Java on every input of a bound and the definition sampled against the JDK on a JVM (lib/tests/claims.rs, claims.P). The claim's predicates as javac compiles them agree with the oracle on all 44 probes (examples/289-spring-security-cve-2022-22978-regex-request-matcher-bypass/proofs/predicates.py). Expected established: outside a URL that begins with the prefix and holds a line terminator, the two releases return the same value.
